title: Montenegro 1943 - Mountain Stream - 15c Italian Occupation Issue Postage Stamp
descriptionText: The product is a 15c Italian Occupation Issue postage stamp from Montenegro, specifically from the year 1943. This mail aerea stamp originates from Montenegro and is of used quality with an ungraded grade. The stamp is uncertified, making it a unique and collectible piece of European postal history.
